content.value: Mr. X is developing an inventory system for a large warehouse. To handle different (15) kinds of items, he decides to create a generic class named Item’ with two member variables itemcode', which is an integer by default but may vary, and item itemcost', which can store a floating point value representing the cost. Now, design the generic item class with a default constructor and a parameterized constructor so that it can manage a wide variety of item types and their respective costs.
